name: Kroger Great Lakes Grocery Distribution Center Delaware OH

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled main entrance on the north side off Nutter Farm Ln. Street View (2026-04) down the drive shows channelized lanes with a row of traffic bollards across the approach, a divided in/out median, and trucks queued single-file in the inbound lane on z20 satellite.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small tan booth structure beside the entry lanes visible in Street View (pano QTw3nP6ij-E3GnXCUCEf_w) just past the GREAT LAKES DISTRIBUTION monument sign, with light poles and a checkpoint canopy. Footprint ~1-2 vehicles.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Entry drive splits around a large teardrop median island into separate inbound and outbound lanes; channelized with bollards.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Outbound lane count estimated from the median split; could not isolate exactly.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Curved paved truck-parking loop on the NW side of the entry (outside the inner yard) holds queued trucks/trailers before the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved aprons and yard lanes inside the gate before the dock faces provide deep internal staging.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long entry approach plus deep internal yard easily holds 3+ trucks before docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided gate apron with multiple lanes and unused paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock-door banks on multiple faces of both buildings; well over 50 doors total (estimate ~220).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yards: a large north drop lot near the entry plus east-side and apron rows, hundreds of parked trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct large buildings (NW and SE) each with their own dock clusters on different faces, indicating separate ship/receive operations.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of two large distribution buildings (NW and SE) on one property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Isolated DC surrounded by farmland on the edge of Delaware, OH; broader setting is rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural setting but on a developed corridor near Delaware/US-23; cellular coverage likely adequate, so left false (medium confidence).
fieldNotes.scale: No clear truck scale/weigh pad identified in available imagery; left false but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the SW property boundary/right-of-way but does not spur into the buildings or docks; no rail-served docks observed.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Approximate from the operational/paved footprint perimeter; the owned parcel including buffer farmland and retention ponds is larger.

citations.claim: Kroger Great Lakes Distribution Center recruiting site lists facility at 2000 Nutter Farms Lane, Delaware OH 43015, actively hiring Warehouse Order Selectors.

verification.rationale: Kroger careers site confirms active Great Lakes DC at exact address; no closure/divestiture for this site.
